title: Power Query Kept the WRONG Row 😳 #excel #powerquery #shorts
description: You sorted newest-first, then Remove Duplicates kept an older row. Microsoft documents that Table.Distinct does not guarantee which duplicate is preserved because query folding or optimization can change evaluation. This realistic Power Query walkthrough shows the predictable keep-first pattern: buffer the sorted table, then run Table.Distinct. #excel #powerquery #datacleaning
visual_style: proof-first realistic Power Query demo with animated row-state transitions and side-by-side verification
research_signal: Microsoft Learn explicitly warns that Table.Distinct does not guarantee which duplicate is preserved and recommends Table.Buffer for predictable duplicate removal.

captions.text: Newest is 01 Oct. Watch what survives.
